title: Build a straight brick wall section
instructions: Show the string line or plumb being set up, lay a short section of brick wall, check it is straight and level, and explain each step out loud.

criteria.text: A string line or plumb is set up before laying
Mortar is mixed to a workable consistency and spread evenly
Joints between bricks are even and filled
The wall is checked for level and plumb
Excess mortar is cleaned off the face
The worker explains each step in their own words
